description: Figure 7, titled “mBERT XLM-RoBERTa comparison by language family,” is a single horizontal bar chart that compares the performance of three models—mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and same (light green)—across nine language families along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis is labeled “task count” and ranges from 0 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10, indicating the number of tasks for which each model performed better. The language families, listed from left to right, are: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. Each language family has three adjacent bars representing the respective models. The tallest bar for each family indicates the model with the highest task count. For example, in the IE-Slavic family, the XLM-R bar reaches approximately 39, the same bar reaches approximately 28, and the mBERT bar reaches approximately 12. In the IE-Romance family, the same bar reaches approximately 30, the XLM-R bar reaches approximately 13, and the mBERT bar reaches approximately 5. The IE-Baltic family shows XLM-R at approximately 10, same at approximately 7, and mBERT at approximately 4. The IE-Germanic family shows XLM-R at approximately 18, same at approximately 22, and mBERT at approximately 3. The IE-Indic family shows XLM-R at approximately 5, same at approximately 4, and mBERT at approximately 1. The IE-other family shows XLM-R at approximately 6, same at approximately 8, and mBERT at approximately 1. The Isolate family shows XLM-R at approximately 5, same at approximately 1, and mBERT at approximately 1. The Semitic family shows XLM-R at approximately 7, same at approximately 1, and mBERT at approximately 1. The Uralic family shows XLM-R at approximately 14, same at approximately 5, and mBERT at approximately 1. The chart includes a legend in the upper right corner that maps the colors to the models: light blue for mBERT, dark blue for XLM-R, and light green for same.
